# ECOSMO E2E

This repository contains the source code for ECOSMO E2E (End to End) model.

The ECOSMO E2E fish functional group model is based on Daewel et al.(GMD,2019).

The modules are described in Vijayakumaran et al., 2026

Vijith Vijayakumaran, Rebecca Millington, Jorn Bruggeman, Josefine Hahn, Helen Powley, Gennadi Lessin, Anja Lindenthal, Corinna Schrum, and Ute Daewel. ECOSMO-E2E v2.0: Generic modules of higher-trophic-level fish and macrobenthos functional groups compatible for two-way coupling to lower-trophic-level model hosts through FABM coupler. In Preparation

Email: Vijith.Vijayakumaran@hereon.de; Ute.Daewel@hereon.de.

The modularisation of ECOSMO E2E model was funded by NECCTON project, Horizon Europe RIA under Grant Number 101081273.
